# QR Code Generator

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified browser distribution from **qrcode-generator 2.0.4**
by Kazuhiko Arase, distributed under the MIT license in `qrcode.LICENSE`.

- Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz
- File in package: `dist/qrcode.js`

Served locally so invitation links stay in the browser during QR generation.
